newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close lower in mixed, volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close lower in mixed, volatile trade.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Monday in a market which was mixed and volatile, prompting caution short term, dealers said.
The general index down 2.75 points, 0.59 percent, to 462.23 and the Ibex fell 31.48 points, 0.59 percent, to 5,273.95.
Santander closed flat at 9,700 after an erratic day's trade following news that it is to propose a three-for-one nominal share split.
Firms announcing 1996 results saw busy trade. Tabacalera ended up 20 pesetas to 6,510. Amper added 170 pesetas to 3,425 after posting a 237 percent rise in net profit.
Corporate profits announcements were fuelling trade, but volume was accounted for mainly by trading rather than final investors, with specific worries overhanging the market.
"We're not seeing wide-scale selling, but rather final clients have disappeared amid uncertainties over monetary union, which should continue to set the tone," a dealer said.
New York's volatility was also weighing shares down, he added.
